what: /design voter prompt loses repo/plan verification permission
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed plan-context branch tells voters they may read only the ballot file, replacing the current permission to silently inspect the plan or referenced repo files; voters can then accept or reject plan-review claims based only on reviewer prose
suggested_fix: For verification-context=plan, preserve the current wording allowing silent inspection of the plan and referenced repo files, or pass explicit --plan-file context through dispatch-plan-voters.sh and document/test that voters may read it

what: The CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT stub will not contain the new helper
scenario_or_breakage: The plan changes dispatch-plan-voters.sh to execute $PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/shared/scripts/render-voter-prompt.sh, but the harness later sets CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT to a temp tree containing only scripts/dispatch-with-waterfall.sh; those scenarios fail before the waterfall stub runs
suggested_fix: Create skills/shared/scripts in the stub plugin root and copy or shim render-voter-prompt.sh there, or restructure the harness so only dispatch-with-waterfall is overridden while helper resolution still uses the real repo root

what: Drift guard covers only two of the four canonical OOS copies
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says the helper, voting-protocol.md, design MAV prose, and implement MAV prose stay byte-synced, but the proposed test only greps rendered output and voting-protocol.md; SKILL.md copies can drift silently while CI stays green
suggested_fix: Add exact grep assertions for skills/design/SKILL.md and skills/implement/SKILL.md in case_canonical_text_drift_guard, using the same hard-coded canonical string

what: HTML comment is targeted inside a fenced prompt template
scenario_or_breakage: Line 93 is currently inside the Voter Prompt Template code fence, so the proposed HTML comment would render as literal template text rather than a hidden maintenance marker, making copy/paste of the canonical template noisy and misleading
suggested_fix: Move the maintenance comment outside the fenced prompt block, or convert the template section so the comment sits in normal Markdown adjacent to a prompt-only fenced block
